notes: Email-style input with concrete rules. Tests extraction of numeric constraints (30 days, 5 business days).

project.audience: online shoppers and customer support agents

input:
Hi team,

For the returns portal: customers enter their order number and email, pick the items they want to return and a reason from a list, and get a prepaid return label as a PDF. Returns are only allowed within 30 days of delivery. Once the warehouse scans the parcel, the customer gets a refund to the original payment method within 5 business days and an email confirming it. Customer support needs to see the status of every return.

Thanks,
Priya

requirements: look up order by order number and email
choose return reason from a list
refund to original payment method within 5 business days
mustNotInvent: a named carrier stated as explicit
